lane: label-free ridge-consensus (magnetic + gravity horizontal-gradient NMS), 3 pre-declared experiments (E1, E2, E3) - budget spent

file.note: Label-free ridge NMS on tmi_hg+iso_hg, top 5% of footprint. Catalogue proxy only; not organizer-scored. DO NOT SUBMIT.

hypothesis: Fault traces produce horizontal-gradient ridges in the magnetic (tmi_hg, band 3) and isostatic-gravity (iso_grav_anom_hg, band 18) fields. Non-maximum suppression across the TMI normal, keeping the top 5% of footprint ridge pixels, should recover a larger share of catalogue-withheld fault cells than either field alone.
mechanism: Edges of magnetised or density-contrasting bodies, including fault-juxtaposed rock units, appear as local maxima of horizontal gradient. NMS across the TMI normal thins these into lineament candidates.
named_non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts and intrusive margins (magnetic and density contrasts that are not faults) produce the same horizontal-gradient ridges. Topography-correlated gravity residuals can also mimic gravity ridges.

holdout.label_class: HOLDOUT-DTI (catalogue proxy, NOT organizer-confirmed, NOT the hidden new-fault set)
holdout.evaluator: src/gems32/metric.py (official continuous-p DTI; alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, R = 3 px = 300 m, triangular kernel)
holdout.split: spatially blocked: q tuned on west half (columns < W/2); frozen q evaluated on east half (columns >= W/2). Label-free candidate, so no catalogue feature exists to leak.
holdout.CI95_method: stratified bootstrap over 8 east row-strips, 2000 draws (approximate; strip components treated as additive)

same_protocol_reference_east_half.label_class: HOLDOUT-DTI proxy, same evaluator, same east region, same catalogue labels
same_protocol_reference_east_half.caveat: Reference rasters may have been built with catalogue knowledge, so this comparison is confounded and does not establish a ranking. Their CIs are in evidence/v4_ridge_experiments.json.

verdict_on_protocol: E2 did not beat the same-protocol reference best (0.19529 GEMSDOE27 on the same east region). Under the protocol this is a NEGATIVE result for promotion.

correlation_and_overlap.lattice_gate_is_structural: LATTICE_r13 is a regular 5-px grid covering 99.87% of footprint cells within 3 px; a random set of 203,418 footprint cells gives 99.88% overlap. The 70% literal gate cannot be passed by any dense candidate. Flagged, not exempted.
